title: DataCore Column
description: A single column in a dataset's logical schema. Used inline inside a dataset's `schema` array, or standalone for column-level documentation.

name.description: Column name as it appears in the data (snake_case recommended).

type.description: Logical data type. Maps to physical types per engine (Parquet, DuckDB, etc.).

description.description: Plain-language description of what the column means and how it should be interpreted.

nullable.description: Whether the column may contain null values. Defaults to true.

unit.description: Unit of measure for numeric columns (e.g., 'VND', 'shares', 'pct', 'tCO2e').

enum.description: If the column is categorical, the closed set of allowed values.

format.description: Optional format hint for parsers and validators (e.g., 'iso8601', 'vn_ticker', 'isin').

examples.description: Sample values to help readers understand the column quickly.
